george.blurb: 冰冻游击机甲。冰霜射击减缓前线，寒冰爆发冻结附近敌群。
george.strengths: 机动性最高。每次射击都会减速。冰霜新星冻结敌群，暴风雪控制大片区域。
george.weakness: 装甲薄，爆发伤害低。抗寒敌人能削弱其伤害和减速效果。

abilityBlurb.0: 快速冰霜射击使敌人减速最多45%，持续1.2秒。
abilityBlurb.1: 短暂无敌滑行；落点造成24点寒冷伤害并冻结0.6秒。
abilityBlurb.2: 半径4的新星造成70点寒冷伤害，冻结1.2秒并减速3秒。
abilityBlurb.3: 持续3秒的冰幕：提升移速、射速和伤害，获得80%减伤。
abilityBlurb.4: 持续5秒的暴风雪：半径7内所有敌人每0.5秒受到18点寒冷伤害并短暂冻结。

leela.blurb: Electric skirmisher. Every shot chains. Storms tear apart anything that gets close.
leela.strengths: Highest mobility. Auto-attacks chain to two nearby targets. Storm Surge zaps every enemy in a wide ring for several seconds.
leela.weakness: Thin armor — eats hits at midrange. Electric-resistant titans absorb the kit.

abilityBlurb.0: Fast electric zap. Each shot chains to two nearby targets.
abilityBlurb.1: I-frame dash; end arcs hit 3 enemies for 14 electric.
abilityBlurb.2: 4-radius electric pulse, then 4 chain hops for 20 each.
abilityBlurb.3: 3s veil: speed, fire rate, damage, and 50% resist.
abilityBlurb.4: 3s storm: 4 electric arcs every 0.5s inside 7 radius.

mike.blurb: Close-range flame mech. Heavy per-shot splash plus burn DoT — turns packs into bonfires.
mike.strengths: Biggest auto-attack splash of any robot. Ignition doubles fire rate. Inferno Ring washes flame waves out in every direction.
mike.weakness: Shortest engagement range. Para and armored matriarchs vent flame at ≤0.5×.

abilityBlurb.0: Short-range flame splash. Every shot hits a small pack.
abilityBlurb.1: I-frame dash that leaves a 2.6s burning coal trail.
abilityBlurb.3: 4s ignition: x2 fire rate, +30% damage, 35% resist.
abilityBlurb.4: 3 expanding flame rings, 95 each, plus burn.

stan.blurb: 动能枪手机甲。快速扇形弹幕扫射敌群，枪林弹雨持续覆盖前方锥形区域。
stan.strengths: 命中射击锥内的所有敌人。交叉火力清扫近处敌群，将枪林弹雨对准密集路线可发挥威力。
stan.weakness: 移动缓慢。身后敌人不受锥形弹幕影响。动能抗性装甲会降低其伤害。

abilityBlurb.0: 快速动能扇形弹幕命中狭窄锥形区域内的所有敌人。
abilityBlurb.1: 短暂无敌翻滚，调整下一轮射击方向。
abilityBlurb.2: 射程6的宽幅扇形弹幕造成120点动能伤害并击退敌人。
abilityBlurb.3: 超频持续5秒：射速+80%，伤害+15%，减伤50%，移动变慢。
abilityBlurb.4: 固定方向持续扫射3.5秒：射程11的锥形区域每0.14秒受到24点动能伤害。移动或冲刺可取消。
